fields.description: Select the customer record that owns and governs this environment.
fields.label: Tenant

fields.description: Optional operator-friendly label used to distinguish this environment beyond the site name.
fields.label: Environment Name

fields.description: Classifies whether this environment is a disposable sandbox, live production site, or staging setup.
fields.label: Environment Type

fields.description: Unique Frappe site identifier for this environment. This should stay stable once the environment exists.
fields.label: Site Name

fields.description: Current lifecycle state of the environment. Change this through controlled server-side actions, not casual manual edits.
fields.label: Site Status
fields.options:
Lead
Sandbox Provisioning
Sandbox Active
Sandbox Expired
Production Qualification
Production Provisioning
Live
Suspended
Archived
Provisioning Failed

fields.description: Short explanation for the current lifecycle state, suspension, expiry, or failure condition.
fields.label: Status Reason

fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent controlled lifecycle transition.
fields.label: Last Transition On

fields.description: Operator or system user that performed the latest lifecycle transition.
fields.label: Last Transition By

fields.description: Policy record that defines default operational guardrails, quotas, and lifecycle rules for this environment.
fields.label: Policy

fields.description: Commercial and infrastructure tier for this environment, such as sandbox, standard, premium, or VIP.
fields.label: Hosting Tier

fields.description: How a sandbox should be initialized for demos: either empty or restored from a prepared demo backup.
fields.label: Demo Seed Mode

fields.description: Reference to the prepared demo backup or template used when seeding sandbox data.
fields.label: Demo Seed Reference

fields.description: Placement intent for the environment so operators can see whether it runs on shared or more isolated infrastructure.
fields.label: Placement Strategy
fields.options:
Shared Runtime Pool
Reserved Runtime Pool
Dedicated Runtime Target
Dedicated Runtime + DB

fields.description: Current estimated monthly infrastructure cost for this environment.
fields.label: Estimated Monthly Cost

fields.description: Latest billing posture copied onto the environment for quick operator visibility.
fields.label: Billing Status Snapshot

fields.description: When usage or cost indicators on this record were last refreshed.
fields.label: Usage Snapshot On

fields.description: Primary infrastructure provider this environment should be associated with for lifecycle and placement decisions.
fields.label: Primary Cloud Provider

fields.description: Runtime host provider for the application layer. This can differ from the primary provider for low-cost sandbox placement.
fields.label: Runtime Provider

fields.description: Underlying provider for the object storage account backing files and retained backups.
fields.label: Object Storage Provider

fields.description: Operational DNS authority for this environment's hostname intent.
fields.label: DNS Provider
fields.options:
Google Cloud DNS
OVH DNS
Other

fields.description: Primary hostname the environment should answer for when public routing is enabled.
fields.label: Primary Domain

fields.description: Declares whether the environment is internal only, publicly routed, or still waiting for routing readiness.
fields.label: Routing Mode

fields.description: Declares whether requests that reach the shared edge proxy should be fully public, restricted to an allowlist, or blocked.
fields.label: Ingress Access Mode

fields.description: Explicit CIDR allowlist enforced by the shared edge proxy when Ingress Access Mode is Allowlisted.
fields.label: Ingress Allowlist

fields.description: Check when DNS records are in place and traffic can resolve to the intended entry point.
fields.label: DNS Ready

fields.description: Check when valid TLS is provisioned for the primary hostname.
fields.label: TLS Ready

fields.description: Expected host header value used by the router or ingress to match requests for this environment.
fields.label: Host Header Value

fields.description: Target deployment region or geography for this environment.
fields.label: Region

fields.description: Frappe branch intended for this environment's runtime image or release line.
fields.label: Frappe Branch

fields.description: Ifitwala Ed branch intended for this environment's application release.
fields.label: Ifitwala Ed Branch

fields.description: Ifitwala Drive branch intended for this environment when that app is part of the deployment.
fields.label: Ifitwala Drive Branch

fields.description: Runtime isolation mode for the app layer. Use this to distinguish shared, reserved, and dedicated runtime placement.
fields.label: Deployment Mode
fields.options:
Shared Runtime
Reserved Runtime
Dedicated Runtime

fields.description: Operator notes explaining why this deployment mode was chosen or any exceptions to the default model.
fields.label: Deployment Mode Notes

fields.description: Shared or reserved runtime pool chosen for this environment when it is placed onto a reusable bench/runtime surface.
fields.label: Runtime Pool

fields.description: Dedicated host, bench, or runtime target planned for this environment when it is not assigned to a shared pool.
fields.label: Dedicated Runtime Target

fields.description: Database isolation mode for the environment. Production defaults should remain explicit here.
fields.label: Database Mode
fields.options:
Shared DB Fleet
Dedicated DB Instance

fields.description: Operational provider category for the database service backing this site.
fields.label: DB Provider
fields.options:
Self Managed
Google Managed
Other Managed

fields.description: Database instance or cluster identifier used by operators to locate the environment's database placement.
fields.label: DB Instance Name

fields.description: Actual database name for this site's isolated database.
fields.label: DB Name

fields.description: Database user allocated to this environment.
fields.label: DB User

fields.description: Check when the database is configured with high-availability protections rather than a single-node profile.
fields.label: DB HA Enabled

fields.description: Most recent successful backup timestamp recorded for this environment's database.
fields.label: DB Last Backup

fields.description: Date of the latest verified restore test for this environment's database backups.
fields.label: DB Restore Tested On

fields.description: Check when realtime and websocket services are enabled for this environment.
fields.label: SocketIO Enabled

fields.description: Named worker sizing or queue-processing profile assigned to this environment.
fields.label: Worker Profile

fields.description: Primary object storage backend used for live site files and attachments shared across Ifitwala Ed and Ifitwala Drive.
fields.label: File Storage Provider

fields.description: Access class used for live file/object reads. The current GCS baseline keeps active files on the frequent-access tier.
fields.label: File Storage Class

fields.description: Allowed file storage quota for this environment in gigabytes.
fields.label: Storage Quota (GB)

fields.description: Object storage backend used for retained exported backups outside the runtime container.
fields.label: Backup Storage Provider

fields.description: Access class used for retained daily backups. The current GCS baseline keeps backups on the less-frequent tier.
fields.label: Backup Storage Class

fields.description: Expiry date for disposable environments such as trials or sandboxes.
fields.label: Expires On

fields.description: High-level health indicator used for fast operator triage.
fields.label: Health Score

fields.description: When health, latency, and saturation indicators were last checked.
fields.label: Last Health Check

fields.description: Average application response time in milliseconds from the latest observation window.
fields.label: Avg Response (ms)

fields.description: Observed error rate for the latest monitoring window.
fields.label: Error Rate Percent

fields.description: Current queued job backlog across workers for this environment.
fields.label: Queue Backlog Count

fields.description: Count of slow database queries detected in the latest observation window.
fields.label: Slow Query Count

fields.description: Operator-facing capacity status derived from health, load, and saturation signals.
fields.label: Capacity State

fields.description: External or internal job identifier for the latest provisioning workflow run.
fields.label: Provisioning Job ID

fields.description: Most recent provisioning step reached before completion, pause, or failure.
fields.label: Last Provisioning Step

fields.description: Latest provisioning outcome, warning, or failure detail visible to operators.
fields.label: Provisioning Message

fields.description: Container, compose project, or runtime identifier for the founder demo runtime used by this environment.
fields.label: Runtime Reference

fields.description: Host or object-storage path where the latest exported site backup for this environment is stored outside the container.
fields.label: Backup Export Path
